profile.name: Nokia C1-02 comparative workload
limitations: Desktop API test doubles, not Nokia firmware or a KVM emulator
Host AWT images and JVM overhead prevent equating a host 2 MiB heap with the device heap
Host time is comparative only; no predicted phone FPS
Native MMAPI latency and native image memory are not modeled
Entry/intro and camera sweep only; quest actions and enlarged puzzles need additional scenarios
Each scene/mode/repeat starts in a separate JVM; automatic scene transitions end the sample
JIT census and -Xint control runs are separate; resource counters are primary and host timing is secondary
Common MIDlet bootstrap is outside the entry measurement; graphics and metadata caches are cleared before each requested entry, OS/JVM ZIP caches are not controlled
Audio output is inactive; MMAPI playback and device audio preparation are excluded
